head: khat
rule: ขาด runs in two branches off the cut. Sense 1 keeps everything where something is SEVERED, and Thai's whole vocabulary of finality sits there, because a thing cut through cannot be rejoined: ตัดขาด, เด็ดขาด, ชี้ขาด, ผูกขาด, ขายขาด, ขาดตัว, ขาดใจ. The LACKING branch (2) takes what ought to be present and is not — ขาดตลาด, ขาดแคลน. SHORTFALL (3) takes what is present but not in full — ขาดทุน, ขาดเหลือ. Sense 5 takes a shortfall measured against a stated number: เดือนขาด, the 29-day month against เดือนเต็ม.
